statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-93687 affects the npm braces package at 3.0.3, the latest release on the public npm registry, so no patched version is available yet. On Prometheus 3.x stable lines the component appears in the SPDX SBOM for bundled web UI static assets built from the prometheus package; the durable remediation is a dependency override in the prometheus HSP package build once upstream publishes a fix. Reachability of the vulnerable recursion path in the shipped static UI bundle is under assessment.

CVE-2026-93687 affects the npm braces package at 3.0.3, the latest release on the public npm registry, so no patched version is available yet. On Prometheus 3.x stable lines the component appears in the SPDX SBOM for bundled web UI static assets built from the prometheus package; the durable remediation is a dependency override in the prometheus HSP package build once upstream publishes a fix. Reachability of the vulnerable recursion path in the shipped static UI bundle is under assessment.

No patched braces release is published on npm yet. The finding is limited to the frontend build SPDX SBOM; runtime node_modules after npm prune does not include braces. Reachability in the shipped image is under assessment until upstream ships a fix.
